assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setbacks), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints are not published in the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: All statutory control indicators are marked unknown in metrics.json; design conclusions remain conceptual until official conditions are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: Boundaries, land use, roads, green/public space, buildings, phasing and all area metrics must be recalculated when official polygons are released; provisional geometry is not an official redline.

assumptions.statement: Existing building stock, land ownership, road redlines, heritage protection ranges, municipal pipelines and traffic conditions are not available as cleared data.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish conclusions, road alignments and infrastructure layouts are conceptual suggestions pending professional verification.

assumptions.statement: All events, developer community operations, scenario opening, branding, international outreach and investment-attraction arrangements are concept proposals, not confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Operation content must not be read as committed implementation.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition, building footprints, road centerlines and scenario nodes are agent-generated design proposals (design_proposal role) for discussion.
assumptions.impact: They describe design intent only and are not statutory plans, approvals or existing conditions.
